One simple ingredient: Made only from Brazilian pasture raised (grass-fed) cows.
Sustainable & ethical: Pasture raised and grass-fed cows (untouched by hormones or antibiotics) graze on pasture that is free from chemical fertilizers or pesticides.
Perfect health benefits: Perfect hydrolyzed collagen is the perfect source for all-natural pure protein.
One serving of Perfect Hydrolyzed Collagen provides 10 grams of protein with zero grams of carb and fat. This exceptional powder is virtually tasteless, odorless, and dissolves in any liquid.
Perfect Hydrolyzed Collagen delivers important amino acids that are difficult to find in our diet, such glycine, proline, and hydroxyproline. Research indicates that the amino acids found in collagen may help:
Build human cartilage
Assist digestion
Support joint health
Improve skin, hair, and nail quality
Collagen is the most abundant protein in the human body, however, as we age our collagen levels decrease. Perfect Hydrolyzed Collagen (a form of gelatin) employs a unique enzymatic process that produces low molecular weight hydrolyzed collagen peptides that are easily digestible and highly bioavailable.
